basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer based in Boston. I have a passion for American football and am a die-hard New England Patriots fan. My interests also include stand-up comedy and climate change discussions. I usually browse Reddit during my breaks at work and in the evenings. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends hiking or hanging out with friends at local comedy clubs.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and have been working in the field for about 5 years. I'm self-taught in climate science and often engage in discussions to understand various perspectives. My love for comedy has led me to explore various comedic styles and techniques.
